subject: Post-demo cost qualification & host-gap analysis
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stanton <emily.stanton@averyhealth.com>, procurement@averyhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: quick cost/volume clarifications + next steps

Hi Emily — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a tight pilot proposal for Avery Health: 

Recap (from our convo):
- Primary workload: user-facing summarization + contextual search (mix of generation + embeddings).
- Estimated steady-state consumption you mentioned: roughly 5–12M generation tokens/month + ~15–25M embedding tokens/month during Q3 pilot.
- Key constraints: predictability (monthly cap), security (SOC2 requirement), and procurement lead time.

To prepare a short pilot SOW and pricing sheet we need two clarifications:
1) Please confirm a target budget range for inference (monthly) so we can map unit economics to your expectations — you mentioned a broad ballpark on the call but we want a concrete range to benchmark against hosts.
2) If you have a preferred comparison set (OpenAI, Anthropic, specific host partners), call that out — we'll include a concise $/1M tokens comparison and show how Redwood’s pilot would stack up.

Attached is a compact initial pricing sketch (Redwood-pilot-pricing-v1.pdf) and a comparative host-sheet we’ll populate if you confirm volumes.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm budget range + any procurement constraints by EOD Fri (3/23).
- We’ll send a 3-month pilot proposal with target unit prices and SLA.

If those timeframes look OK I’ll loop in Contracts for a short SOW.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-pilot-pricing-v1.pdf]

From: Emily Stanton <emily.stanton@averyhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@averyhealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 15:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: quick cost/volume clarifications + next steps

Ben — appreciate the quick follow-up and the deliverables. A few details from Procurement and product so you can tighten the numbers: 

Confirmed volumes (expected for pilot period):
- Generation tokens: 5M–12M / month (peak month expectation ~12M).
- Embedding tokens: ~20M / month (for semantic search + similarity indexing).

Budget guidance (high level):
- Monthly budget for inference + hosting we can allocate for pilot: $2,000 — $7,500. This is a stretch depending on measured ROI; procurement prefers a capped pilot.

Target unit expectations (what the product team is asking us to aim for):
- Gen model effective target: $6 — $11 per 1M tokens (they called this market-competitive but not at highest-end host pricing).
- Embedding target: $1 — $3 per 1M tokens.

Procurement has attached our standard intake form — please include any required security artifacts and sample invoice cadence. We’d also like to see explicit comparisons vs OpenAI and Anthropic for the gen workloads.

Thanks,
Emily Stanton
Director, Product — Avery Health
[Attachment: Avery-Procurement-Form.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stanton <emily.stanton@averyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: quick cost/volume clarifications + next steps

Emily — perfect, that budget guidance helps a lot. Below is a concise benchmarking snapshot (we’ve listed representative public/host rates — actual SKU names vary):

Representative public host $/1M tokens (gen, approximate):
- OpenAI (current standard seq-gen SKU): ~$28 / 1M tokens
- Anthropic (Claude-instant style): ~$18 / 1M tokens
- Large open-host A (unoptimized): ~$12 / 1M tokens

Important notes on comparators:
- Public host rates above are list prices; volume discounts and reserved commitments materially lower unit prices.
- Open-model self-hosted stacks can be cheaper on raw per-token compute but often require infra/ops investment and don’t include our runtime optimizations (prefix caching, batching, KV management) which meaningfully lower effective cost per served API call.

Suggested Redwood pilot pricing (3-month pilot, capped):
- Generation: $8.00 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings: $2.00 / 1M tokens
- Pilot terms: 20% off month 1, 1-month notice, monthly cap = pilot volume + 20% buffer.

Why this hits your targets:
- At the mid pilot estimate (10M gen + 20M embed / month) this maps to ~ $100 / month (embed) + $80 / month (gen) at unit prices above? (Note: example numbers here are illustrative — we’ll produce a full cost table in the SOW).

Concrete next steps I’ll take this morning:
1) Populate the attached comparison-host-pricing-sheet.csv with the line-item math vs OpenAI/Anthropic and include total pilot spend scenarios at low/mid/high volumes.
2) Draft a short SOW + pricing annex for a 3-month capped pilot (SLA targets + SOC2 attestation reference).
3) Loop Contracts for a simple MSA/SOW signature path and mark procurement contact as primary.

If that plan looks good I’ll aim to get the populated comparison and draft SOW to you by EOD Mon (3/27).

Cheers — Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: comparison-host-pricing-sheet.csv]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Avery Health — pilot pricing & contract prep (please action)

Marissa / Laura — internal note following Emily’s budget confirmation (see thread above). Action items so Contracts and Pricing are aligned with the $8 / $2 pilot targets: 

Urgent asks:
- Marissa: can you validate that $8/1M gen + $2/1M embed is margin-acceptable for a 3-month pilot at the expected volumes (5–12M gen, 15–25M embed)? Also include options for a reserved capacity discount if they commit 6+ months.
- Laura: please prepare a short SOW + pricing annex template capped at the pilot volumes. Include: SLA 99.5% uptime for serving, data isolation notes, and an invoice cadence monthly in arrears. Add a 20% off first-month credit line.
- Both: mark Contract term with procurement escalation path and a max pilot cap number. I’ll send the populated comparison sheet and the hubspot deal link to include in the SOW.

Attachments referenced to share with customer once validated: Redwood-pilot-pricing-v1.pdf, comparison-host-pricing-sheet.csv, Avery-Procurement-Form.pdf

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
